inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: fundzo lemvelo ngemikhiqizo yekhabhoni, lutfuli lwekhabhoni, maseluleko lokusimama, tintfo letimangalisa nendzaba temvelo.

hero.titulo: Nome ngumkhuba omncane uyehlisa kancane umtfwalo kulelive
hero.texto: CARBONO CONSCIENTE AYISIPHAWU LELIHLATSA NOMBE LIHLOSO LELIKUDZE — KULUHLANGANO LWEKUKHETSA KOJWAYELEKILE, KUPHINDWA LUSUKU NGALUNYE: KUTSI UTJALA NI, UHAMBA UNJANI, NGABE UVALA LIBHANYABHANYA, UKHALA KUPHI LUDZOVU.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Kukhishwa kwekhabhoni kukhishwa kwemagesi lafana ne-CO₂ emoyeni, ikakhulukati ngokushiswa kwemafutha lasendzalo, kugawulwa kwemahlatsi, kukhiqizwa kwemafektri kanye nangetfulelo lwelusuku nalusuku.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Emagesi akha umkhumbi lobamba kushisa emoyeni. Lokukhishwa kwemagesi kungakhula, umphumela uyakhula naye — yiko lokubangela kushisa kwemhlaba nakuphendukela kwesimo selitulu.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Yinani lelipheletile lemagesi lacalisa kushisa emoyeni, akhiqizwa, ngalokucacile nome ngalokungacacile, kutenzo temuntfu, inkampani nome umkhiqizo mphumela welusuku nalusuku.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Khabhoni engacali ifuna kulinganisa nome kuvuselela lokukhishiwe. Carbono consciente ibeka cucu lekukhetsa lokuncipisa umphumela emvelweni ngaphambi kwekucabanga nge kuvuselela.

alimentacao.resumo: Tikhetho yetafula letincipisa kumosakala nekukhishwa kwemagesi

reciclagem.resumo: Hlukanisa, phindze usebentise kabutjha futsi unike lusebenti lusha kutintfo letisele
reciclagem.item3: Yisa izimphahla letingasetjentiswa kabutjha endzaweni lefanele

fatos.fato1: Sihlahla lesikhulile sitfunga, ngekulinganisa, ema-kg langu-22 CO₂ ngemnyaka — ngulesizatfu kugcwalisa tihlahla kabusha kuyindlela yimbili yekulinganisa lokukhishwa kwemoya.
fatos.fato2: Lwandle lutfunga ngekulinganisa inkhigho yinye kwemine yeCO₂ yonkhe lekhishwa bantfu ngemnyaka wonkhe, lusebenta njengelilungisa likhulu lelilawula simo-sulwelwe lwemhlaba wonkhe.
fatos.fato3: Kuphindze kusetjentiswa kwelitoni lelinye lemaphepha kongela tihlahla ema-17 kanye nemanti nemandla lamanyenti, uma kucatsaniswa nekukhiqizwa kwemaphepha lamasha.
fatos.fato4: Tetfulula letihhambisa babantfu tingumtimba lebangela kulinganiso yinkhigho yinye kwemine yeCO₂ yemhlaba lehlobene nemandla — kushintja imoto ngelivigikili nome tetfulula temphakatsi emhambeni lemfishane kwenta umehluko wecinisile.
fatos.fato5: Igceke le-Amazon likhaya lezinto letiphila eti-10% tako kwehlukahlukana kwetintfo letiphilako letatiwa emhlabeni, futsi licongza ema-billion yetoni tekhabhoni etihlahleni tako.
fatos.fato6: Amapaneli yelilanga emakhaya angancisisa umlayeto wekhabhoni wendlu kutonitoni teCO₂ ngemnyaka, kusho kudzinga kuhlobene nendlela yemandla yasendaweni.
fatos.fato7: Kudla inyama lebovu lencane kungancisisa kakhulu umlayeto wekhabhoni womuntfu, ngobe kufuywa kwetinkhomo kungekunye kwemisebenti yetelimo lenemkhiqizo lomnyenti wekukhishwa kwemoya.
fatos.fato8: Kuncibilikisa kwelichaba lwelwandle le-Arctic kuncisisa amandla emhlaba wekubuyisela kukhanya kwelilanga esibhakabhakeni, kusheshisa kushisa — umphumela lowatiwa 'njengembuyiselo yealbedo'.
fatos.fato9: Ema-LED asebentisa mandla lamancane kufikela ku-80% kunemabhalbhu akudzala, futsi ahlala sikhatsi lesidze, kungcisise kukhishwa kanye nemadoti.
fatos.fato10: Sivumelwano se-Paris, lesayinwe matiko langaba ngu-200, sinenhloso yekunciphisa kushisa kwemhlaba ngaphansi kwa-2°C ngenhla kwamazinga langaphambi kwemisebenti yemafektri.
fatos.fato11: Kungaba ingxenye yinye kwetintathu tekudla konkhe lokukhiqizwa emhlabeni kulahlwa — futsi loku kulahla kodvwa kukhiqiza ingxenye lebalulekile yekukhishwa kwemoya temhlaba.
fatos.fato12: Tiphothela temoya temanje tingakhiqiza mandla lanele kunika magesi emakhaya lafikela etinkhulungwane, ngaphandle kwekukhipha CO₂ ngesikhatsi sisebenta.
fatos.fato13: Umhlabatsi lophilile ucongza khabhoni lenyenti kunetintfo tonkhe letiphilako kanye nelisibhakabhaka kuhlangene — tendlela temasimu letivuselela tisita kugcina khabhoni emhlabatsini.
fatos.fato14: Imifantfu yekorali, nakuba imboza ngaphansi kwa-1% yelisisekelo lwelwandle, isekela kungaba ema-25% kwimphilo yelwandle yonkhe letiwako — futsi inemtelelo kakhulu kushisa kwemanti.
fatos.fato15: Kuncisisa kulahlwa kwemanti lashisa ekhaya (sibonelo, kugeza sikhatsi lesifishane) kuncisisa nako kukhishwa kwemoya, ngobe kushisisa emanti kusebentisa mandla.
fatos.fato16: Timoto temagesi, nakuba kubalwa nekukhiqizwa kwelibhethri, titsandza kukhipha CO₂ lencane ngesikhatsi sako sonkhe sekuphila kunetimoto tefueli, ikakhulukati lapho magesi avela etinhlotsini letihlobile.
fatos.fato17: Kwenta kompost yemadoti lavela etintfweni letiphilako ekhaya kuvimbela kukhishwa kwegesi lemethane etindzaweni temadoti — ligesi lelimbi kakhulu kuneCO₂ esikhatsini lesifishane.
fatos.fato18: Ema-glacier aseGreenland kanye ne-Antarctica ndzawonye alahlekelwa, eminyakeni yakamuva, emakhulu ebhiliyoni etoni telichaba ngemnyaka, kusita ngekusheshisa kukhuphuka kwelizinga lwelwandle.

globo.sem_dados_territorio: Akukho imininingwane yekukhishwa kweCO₂ ngamunwe ngamunye lekhona kulelive.
globo.fonte_estimativa: Kulinganisa kweCO₂ yendzalo ngamunwe ngamunye (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, umnyaka wesisekelo 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: Imbulunga lesebentisana nemuntfu yekukhishwa kwekhabhoni. Donsa kuze ijikeleze, skrola kuze isondzele, cindzetela live kuze ubone imininingwane, futsi ucindzetele kabili kuze imbulunga ibekwe endleleni yokuvezwa.
globo.aria_decorativo: Imbulunga yemhlobiso lejikelezako, ikhombisa ligadango lelive lelihlanganisene leprojekthi yeCarbono Consciente.
